text:
sarah: Hey team, just got a customer report — CSV export from Console is returning empty files for some accounts. They said the header row is present but no data rows. ticket #INC-2026-0421.

 tom: Which export and what filters did they use? date range, model, etc?

 sarah: Full usage export -> Analytics > Exports > Export CSV. They selected a 6-week range (2026-01-01 to 2026-02-15). Also said some filenames are 0 bytes.

 liam: Can we repro locally? Asking for request id / user id and a sample curl.

 sarah: Customer provided request id 8f3b9c2 and org id org_9hu4. They included a curl they ran: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://console.redwood.com/api/exports?start=2026-01-01&end=2026-02-15&type=usage" -o out.csv -v``` They said server returned 200 but out.csv size is 44 bytes (header only).

 anya: Also got a note that rows were truncated in a different account when the dataset included emojis (e.g. user messages with 😅). Could be encoding or a streaming/chunking bug.

 liam: Ok — two hypotheses: 1) background job hits a paging bug for ranges > 30 days and returns no rows, 2) encoding/streaming error causes early EOF. I'll check exporter job logs. Can support provide the export job id?

 sarah: Job id from console UI: export_job_2026_02_15_77. Customer attached server response headers: `Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8` and `Content-Length: 44`.

 liam: Thanks. I'm tailing the exporter logs now. @devops-bot can you pull logs for export_job_2026_02_15_77 across worker-* for the 02:30-02:40 UTC window?

 devops-bot: Logs queued. Fetching from worker-3, worker-7, worker-9. ETA ~30s.

 liam: Found this in worker-7: `ERROR exporter: pagination failed: next_token empty but rows_expected > 0` followed by `panic: write to response failed: broken pipe` then truncated stack. Looks like a pagination edge-case returned empty next_token prematurely.

 anya: That matches both reports — pagination returns no rows for large ranges, but we still respond with 200 and header (content-length set based on buffer), causing zero-byte or partial CSVs. Also emoji truncation might be a separate streaming flush/encoding issue.

 tom: Priority? Customer is impacted (billing analytics broken).

 liam: High. I'll open a PR with a guard: if next_token empty but more_rows_expected -> retry once and fallback to full-scan. Adding metrics for pagination_failures.

 sarah: Customer asks for workaround in the meantime.

 anya: Workaround: advise them to split date range to < 30-day chunks. Also recommend switching export format to JSONL as temporary since streaming flush seems more robust for emoji content.

 liam: Repro steps I used locally: 1) seed test org with 100k usage rows spanning 6 weeks, 2) run export API call above, 3) observe logs and curl out.csv size. Example command: ```python tools/seed_usage.py --org org_test_big --rows 100000 --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-02-15 && curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.com/api/exports?start=2026-01-01&end=2026-02-15&type=usage" -o out.csv -v```

 liam: Created GH issue redwood/console#819 with debug logs and linked to internal incident. Will draft a small hotfix: retry pagination once and ensure response buffering doesn't set final content-length until streaming completes.

 tom: Any chance this is related to recent change in the pager library? We bumped page_size default to 10k last week.

 liam: Good call — bisect points to pager v1.3.4 -> v1.4.0 bump as the first failure commit. Adding a pinned rollback in the PR until upstream fixes.

 anya: For encoding/truncation with emojis, I'm going to add a test that includes multi-byte UTF-8 chars and assert stream writes finish without exception.

 sarah: Customer updated ticket: they tried splitting the date range and it worked for now. They want ETA on fix.

 liam: Outline: PR today for rollback + pagination-guard, QA tomorrow, hotfix deploy tomorrow evening UTC. Will update ticket with ETA ~24-36 hrs.

 tom: Please paste the PR link here when ready so support can notifiy customer.

 liam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/1245 (draft). Contains rollback to pager v1.3.4 and pagination guard.

 anya: I'll add regression tests and a small e2e exporting job in CI to run with emoji payloads.

 sarah: Perfect. I'll update the ticket with workaround and PR link. Thanks all :thumbsup:

 liam: Follow-up: added logs to Sentry group export-pagination-failures and a metric exporter.csv.pagination_fail_count. We should alert if >5 failures / 10m.

 tom: Noted. I'll add an alert in PagerDuty rule for that metric.

 sarah: Closing internal escalation for now — moving to monitoring + patching. Will reopen if customer reports again.

 liam: Closing loop: hotfix rolled out 2026-02-20 18:40 UTC, customer confirmed exports succeeded for previously failing ranges. Ticket updated and resolved.
